name: Todo
description: Multi-list todo with priority, deadlines, reminders, search, and pinning. Managed from chat and the desktop panel.

tools.name: add
tools.title: Add Todo
tools.description: Add one item to a todo list. Use this whenever the user asks to remember, track, or be reminded of a task. Optionally specify listId, priority (1=high, 2=normal, 3=low), pinned, a dueAt deadline, and a remindAt reminder time.

title.description: What needs to be done, in the user's own words.

listId.description: Which list to add to. Defaults to 'inbox'. Use list_all to see available lists.

pinned.description: Pin to top of the list. Default false.

dueAt.description: Deadline, ISO 8601. Use YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day deadline ("due Monday") or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM for a timed one. Resolve relative wording like "tomorrow" / "next Monday" / "下周一" against today's date before calling; never pass the phrase itself. Pass an empty string to clear.

remindAt.description: When to raise the reminder, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the user's local time. A date with no time reminds at 09:00 local. Resolve relative wording before calling. This badges the Todo app icon; it does not send a system notification. Pass an empty string to clear.

tools.name: list
tools.title: List Todos
tools.description: List todo items with optional filters: by status, list, priority, pinned, deadline window, and text search. Returns items sorted by pinned first, then soonest deadline, then priority. Use due="overdue" to answer "what did I miss".

status.description: Which items to return. Defaults to open.

listId.description: Filter to a specific list. Omit for all lists.

pinned.description: If true, return only pinned items.

due.description: Filter by deadline: overdue = past due, today = due by end of today, week = due within 7 days, none = no deadline set, any = has a deadline.

tools.name: complete
tools.title: Complete / Reopen Todo
tools.description: Mark one todo item as done, or reopen it. Call list first to get the item id.

completed.description: True to complete, false to reopen. Defaults to true.

tools.name: update
tools.title: Update Todo
tools.description: Update a todo item's title, priority, pinned status, deadline, or reminder time. Only provided fields are changed; pass an empty string to dueAt or remindAt to clear it.

dueAt.description: Deadline, ISO 8601. Use YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day deadline ("due Monday") or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM for a timed one. Resolve relative wording like "tomorrow" / "next Monday" / "下周一" against today's date before calling; never pass the phrase itself. Pass an empty string to clear.

remindAt.description: When to raise the reminder, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the user's local time. A date with no time reminds at 09:00 local. Resolve relative wording before calling. This badges the Todo app icon; it does not send a system notification. Pass an empty string to clear.

tools.name: pin
tools.title: Pin Todo
tools.description: Pin a todo item to the top of its list.

tools.name: unpin
tools.title: Unpin Todo
tools.description: Remove pin from a todo item.

tools.name: move
tools.title: Move Todo
tools.description: Move a todo item to a different list.

listId.description: Target list id. Use list_all to see available lists.

tools.name: remove
tools.title: Delete Todo
tools.description: Permanently delete one todo item. This cannot be undone; prefer complete when the user simply finished the task.

tools.name: list_create
tools.title: Create List
tools.description: Create a new todo list (category). Use when the user wants to organize tasks into separate lists like 'work', 'shopping', etc.

tools.name: list_all
tools.title: List All Lists
tools.description: List all todo lists (categories) with their open and completed item counts.

tools.name: list_delete
tools.title: Delete List
tools.description: Delete a todo list. Items in it are moved to 'inbox'. This cannot be undone.

id.description: List id to delete. Cannot delete 'inbox'.

tools.name: clear_completed
tools.title: Clear Completed Todos
tools.description: Permanently delete all completed todo items, optionally scoped to one list.

listId.description: Optional list id to scope the cleanup to. Omit to clear completed across all lists.
